_comment: Write-and-validate fixture set. Each case is one clinical note excerpt about one
medication; the agent must produce a FHIR R4B MedicationStatement for it.
`expected` is the scoring ground truth and is never shown to the agent:
Synthea RxNorm content), `dosage` is the regimen the note documents (dose per
single administration), and `max_daily_dose` is a per-drug safety ceiling in
dose_unit. `dosage: null` means the note documents no regimen, so the resource
must not contain one. Case selection: an easy active case, a brand-name lookup
(Tylenol), per-administration dose arithmetic (two tablets), a completed course,
a stopped medication, a strength disambiguation (25 vs 100 MG ER), and a denial
